_comment: Production Web3Auth -> SSS pilot for VetPass (web only; VetPass has no Capgo channel). Mirrors learncard/config.sss-pilot.json: nitro escrow on LearnCard's production enclave, whose authority tenant is 'learncard'. Base config.json leaves VetPass escrow off; the SSS switch PR turns it on for everyone. Keep the pins equal to learncard/config.json (escrowTenantParity.test.ts). See the Confluence LC page 'Production Web3Auth SSS migration runbook'.
